robot.note: Fix the insight: it says Michael Jackson was fourteen on 3 November 1973, but he was born on 29 August 1958 and was fifteen. Correct the age or leave it out; every date and age must be stated by a source.

dhamal-sufi.note: This page describes Dhamail, the Sylheti (Bengali) women's folk dance sung to Radha–Krishna songs, not the Sufi dhamal of Sindh and Punjab. Name the page 'Dhamail' (also spelled Dhamal) and say in the first sentence that it is the Sylheti dance; do not mix in material about the Sufi dhamal.

kaze-no-bon.note: Centre the page on the dance, not on the festival programme: the Owara dances performed through the streets of Yatsuo, the men's and women's choreographies, the dancers' posture, hands and the amigasa straw hats worn low over the face, and the Etchu Owara-bushi music (singer, shamisen, kokyu, taiko). Describe each only as far as the sources allow.

hula-kahiko.note: Rescue: the insight must name something concrete (a person, a place, a year, an object such as the ipu or pahu); remove promotional phrasing; add a sacred_note that explains the chant (oli/mele) and teacher (kumu hula) protocols the sources describe.

jazz-dance.note: Rescue: give at least six claims, each with its verbatim quote from a fetched source; remove promotional phrasing; separate jazz dance as social dance (1920s–40s) from theatrical jazz dance (Jack Cole, Fosse) as the sources do.

rueda-de-casino.note: Rescue: give at least six claims with verbatim quotes; describe the circle (rueda) formation, the caller (líder) and the called figures by name as the sources list them.

zapin.note: Rescue: two archive sources were added (Malaysian Department of Culture and Arts). Use them for the structure (the opening taqsim on the gambus, the numbered steps with the kopak transition, the closing wainab), the instruments (gambus, marwas, and in Zapin Lenga also rebana, violin, accordion, harmonium, gong) and the marwas setting the tempo.

circassian-dance.note: Not a double of lezginka (the editor keeps both). Circassian (Adyghe) dances such as Kafa, Udzh and Islamey are their own tradition. A source on Circassian music was added: name the instruments (pshine accordion, pkhachich clappers, bereban drum, shichepshin fiddle) and the meters it gives for named dances.

giddha.note: Rescue: the insight must be concrete (the boliyan couplets sung in turn, the clapping ring, a place or a year from the sources); remove promotional phrasing.
